newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: IPCL posts NZ$1.93 million year net profit.
newsitem.headline: IPCL posts NZ$1.93 million year net profit.

text.p: Independent Press Communications Ltd, a subsidiary of Independent Newspapers Plc, on Thursday announced a net profit of NZ$1.93 million for the year to December 31.
IPCL was the bidding vehicle of INP in last year's successful takeover of New Zealand publisher Wilson and Horton.

IPCL Chairman Michael Walls said: "The company's only significant investment in this period was in the ordinary shares of Wilson & Horton, and the company's results were therefore closely related to the results of that company, which has already released a preliminary announcement in respect of the year ended on December 31, 1996."
The IPCL result was on total operating revenue of NZ$122.98 million and after tax of NZ$6.39 million.
Wilson and Horton, which is 85.4 percent owned by INP, reported net profit of NZ$40.1 million for the year to December 31. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
